title: Isolation and culture of pure adult mouse microglia and astrocytes for in vitro characterization and analyses
protocol: Sacrifice the mouse using CO2.
Spray the mouse with ethanol, and then decapitate it using sterile scissors.
Remove the skull from the head using fresh sterile scissors and forceps.
Place the brain in a 50 mL Falcon tube containing 1 mL ice-cold PBS-g.
Prepare the enzyme mix by adding 50 μL Enzyme P, 1,900 μL Buffer Z, 20 μL Buffer Y and 10 μL Enzyme A to a C-tube.
Add ×1 adult mouse brain to the C-tube and roughly chop with a scalpel.
Place the C-tube on the gentleMACS Octo Dissociator machine with heaters and select program 37°C_ABDK_01.
Once the program is complete (after 30 min), remove the C-tube and centrifuge it at 500 × g for 5 s to collect all homogenized brain contents at the bottom of the tube.
Resuspend the brain homogenate and filter through a 70 μm cell strainer into a 50 mL Falcon tube.
Wash the C-tube with 10 mL ice-cold PBS-g.
Pass the contents through a cell strainer into a Falcon tube to collect residual brain homogenate.
Centrifuge the filtered brain homogenate at 300 × g for 10 min at 4°C.
Gently remove the supernatant from the brain homogenate pellet.
Resuspend the brain homogenate pellet in 1 mL ice-cold PBS-g.
Transfer the resuspended brain homogenate to a 15 mL Falcon tube.
Top up the brain homogenate to a final volume of 3,100 μL with PBS-g.
Add 900 μL Debris Removal Solution to the brain homogenate and mix gently but thoroughly.
Gently overlay the brain homogenate with 4 mL PBS-g.
Centrifuge the overlaid brain homogenate at 3,000 × g for 10 minutes at 4°C with no brake.
Remove the top two layers containing debris and buffer after centrifugation.
Fill the 15 mL Falcon tube with PBS-g and centrifuge at 1,000 × g for 10 minutes at 4°C with brake.
Remove the supernatant from the Falcon tube.
Resuspend the cell pellet in 1 mL of Red Blood Cell Removal solution.
Incubate the resuspended cells at 4°C for 10 minutes.
Add 10 mL PBS containing 1% FCS to stop red blood cell lysis after incubation.
Centrifuge the Falcon tube at 300 × g for 10 minutes at 4°C.
Resuspend the cell pellet in the desired medium for either direct isolation of microglia using CD11b magnetic sorting or culture as an adult mixed glial culture.
Resuspend the bulk brain cell suspension using 90 μL MACS buffer per 1 × 10^7 cells.
Add 10 μL of anti-CD11b magnetic beads per 1 × 10^7 cells.
Incubate at 4°C for 15 minutes.
Wash the cells with 2 mL MACS buffer.
Pellet the cells by centrifugation at 300 × g for 10 minutes at 4°C.
Aspirate the cell supernatant.
Prepare a MACS MS column and place it onto an OctoMACS magnetic separator.
Apply 500 μL MACS buffer to the strainer of the MS column.
Resuspend the cells in 500 μL MACS buffer.
Apply the cell suspension to the MS column through the 70 μm cell strainer.
Wash the cell strainer and column 3 times with 500 μL MACS buffer.
Add 1 mL MACS buffer to the MS column and remove it from the magnetic strip.
Expel the MACS buffer through the column using the supplied plunger into a fresh 15 mL Falcon tube (this constitutes the ‘CD11bpos cells’ fraction, containing microglia).
Pellet the CD11bpos cells by centrifugation at 300 × g for 10 min at 4°C.
Aspirate the cell supernatant.
Resuspend the CD11bpos cell pellet in 300 μL AGM.
Perform flow cytometry to determine the microglial purity at day 0.
Count live cells using a hemocytometer with Trypan Blue exclusion.
Seed microglia at 3 × 10^5 cells per cm² well size in AGM containing 50 ng/mL GM-CSF and 100 ng/mL M-CSF, and culture the cells in a 37°C/5% CO2 incubator for 5 days.
Change the culture media the day after seeding, and every subsequent second day.
Assay microglia for phenotypes of interest on day 5 after seeding.
Resuspend the bulk brain cell suspension in 7.5 mL AGM containing 50 ng/mL GM-CSF and 100 ng/mL M-CSF.
Add the resuspended cell suspension to a T25 cell culture grade flask (day 0).
Culture adult mixed glial cells at 37°C/5% CO2 for 11–14 days.
On day 5 of culture, remove half the media and discard it.
Replace with fresh AGM containing 50 ng/mL GM-CSF and 100 ng/mL M-CSF.
On day 10 in culture, replace all media with fresh AGM containing 50 ng/mL GM-CSF and 100 ng/mL M-CSF.
Top up the media to a total of 10 mL on days 11–14.
Shake the flask at 180 rpm at 37°C without CO2 for 2.5 hours.
Transfer the culture media (containing microglia) from the flask to a 50 mL Falcon tube.
Collect any remaining cells adhering to the flask with 5 mL ice-cold PBS and add this wash to the Falcon tube containing the microglia.
Centrifuge the Falcon tube at 300 × g for 10 minutes at room temperature to pellet the microglial cells.
Resuspend the microglial cell pellet in 300 μL AGM.
Count live cells using a hemocytometer with Trypan Blue exclusion.
Perform flow cytometry to determine microglial purity.
Seed microglia at 3 × 10^5 cells per cm^2 well size in AGM containing 50 ng/mL GM-CSF and 100 ng/mL M-CSF.
Culture the cells in a 37°C/5% CO2 incubator for 2 days.
Assay microglia for phenotypes of interest on day 2 after seeding.
Add 2.5 mL of pre-warmed 37°C trypsin-EDTA to the flask and incubate in a 37°C/5% CO2 incubator for 5 min.
Disrupt the astrocyte layer by firmly tapping the flask underside and return to the incubator for a further 5 min.
Once again disrupt the astrocyte layer by firmly tapping the flask underside.
Add 5 mL of AGM to the flask to inactivate the trypsin.
Using a cell scraper, gently scrape any cells that remain adherent to the flask.
Transfer the cell culture media from the flask to a new 50 mL Falcon tube.
Pellet the cells by centrifuging at 300 × g for 10 min at room temperature.
Aspirate the cell supernatant.
Resuspend the cell pellet in 2 mL PBS.
Apply the resuspended cells to a new 50 mL Falcon tube via a 70 μm cell strainer to remove debris and obtain a single cell suspension.
Wash the cell strainer with 10 mL PBS into the Falcon tube to collect any remaining cells.
Centrifuge this tube at 300 × g for 10 min to pellet the cells.
Aspirate the supernatant.
Resuspend the cells in 90 μL MACS buffer per flask.
Count live cells using a hemocytometer with Trypan Blue exclusion.
Add 10 μL of anti-CD11b magnetic beads per 1 × 10^7 cells.
Incubate at 4°C for 15 min.
Wash the cells with 2 mL MACS buffer.
Pellet the cells by centrifuging at 300 × g for 10 min at 4°C.
Aspirate the cell supernatant.
Prepare a MACS MS column (each MS column can process ≤1 × 10^7 cells).
Place the MS column onto the OctoMACS separator.
Place a 70 μm cell strainer on top of the column and apply 1 mL MACS buffer to the strainer so it equilibrates the column.
Place a 15 mL Falcon tube underneath the MS column to collect the CD11b-negative flow-through fraction (‘purified astrocytes’ tube).
Resuspend the cell pellet from step in 500 μL MACS buffer.
Apply these cells to the MS column via the 70 μm cell strainer.
Wash the cell strainer and column 3 times with 500 μL MACS buffer.
Collect all flow-through fractions into the ‘purified astrocytes’ tube.
Pellet the astrocytes by centrifugation at 300 × g for 10 min at 4°C.
Aspirate the cell supernatant.
Resuspend the astrocyte pellet in 300 μL AGM.
Count live cells using a hemocytometer with Trypan Blue exclusion.
Perform flow cytometry to determine cell purity.
Perform immunohistochemistry to determine cell purity.
Seed astrocytes in AGM at 3 × 10^5 cells per cm^2 well size.
Change the astrocyte medium every second day after seeding.
Assay astrocytes for phenotypes of interest on day 5 after seeding.
Stain cells for cell surface markers.
Incubate stained cells in 50 μL PBS in a 96-well round-bottomed plate for 20 min on ice, in the dark.
Wash cells by applying 150 μL PBS and centrifuging at 600 × g for 5 min at room temperature (RT).
Aspirate the cell supernatant.
Resuspend cells in 100 μL PBS and transfer to FACS tubes containing 150 μL PBS if not staining for intracellular markers.
Resuspend cells in 100 μL BD FixPerm solution and incubate at 4°C for 20 min, in the dark.
Wash cells by applying 100 μL 1× BD FixPerm Wash buffer and centrifuging at 600 × g for 5 min.
Stain for intracellular markers (e.g., CD68) in 50 μL 1× BD FixPerm Wash buffer.
Incubate the cells on ice in the dark for 15 min.
Wash by applying 150 μL 1× BD FixPerm Wash buffer and centrifuge at 600 × g for 5 min.
Aspirate the cell supernatant.
Resuspend the cells in 100 μL PBS.
Transfer cells to FACS tubes containing 150 μL PBS.
Run cells through a flow cytometer (e.g., BD LSR Fortessa X-20) to analyze marker expression.
Use unstained and single-stained samples to set appropriate PMT voltage, and to distinguish positive and negative populations.
Prepare additional single-stained samples to measure for auto-compensation.
Export data from the flow cytometer software (e.g., FACSDiva as FCS files).
Load exported data into analysis software such as FlowJo.
Use FMO samples to determine gating strategies described in Figure 1 to analyze marker expression.
Plot percentages of interest using general data analysis software (e.g., GraphPad Prism).
Assess and compare purity and phenotypes across samples and biological replicates.
Coat 12 mm 1.0′ coverslips with 500 μL Poly-L-lysine solution (1:10 dilution in water) by incubating for 1 h at RT in a 24-well plate.
Wash coverslips three times with sterile PBS and leave overnight at 4°C to dry.
Plate adult microglia (100,000 cells/500 μL) on Poly-L-lysine-coated coverslips.
Culture cells for an additional 2 days in a 37°C/5% CO2 incubator.
Aspirate the cell culture media and wash cells twice with PBS.
Fix cells with 4% paraformaldehyde (PFA) for 15 min at RT.
Wash coverslips three times with PBS.
Block unspecific binding site with 0.5% BSA/PBS for 30 min at RT.
Stain cells with anti-Iba1 antibody in 0.5% BSA/PBS for 1 hour at room temperature.
Wash the coverslips 5 times with PBS, each wash lasting 5 minutes.
Stain cells with anti-GFAP antibody in 0.5% BSA/PBS for 1 hour at room temperature.
Wash the coverslips 5 times with PBS, each wash lasting 5 minutes.
Stain cells with DAPI in 0.5% BSA/PBS for 1 hour at room temperature.
Stain cells with phalloidin 647 in 0.5% BSA/PBS for 1 hour at room temperature.
Stain cells with Alexa Fluor 488 anti-goat antibody in 0.5% BSA/PBS for 1 hour at room temperature.
Stain cells with Alexa Fluor 594 anti-rabbit antibody in 0.5% BSA/PBS for 1 hour at room temperature.
Wash the coverslips 5 times with PBS, each wash lasting 5 minutes.
Mount the coverslips on microscope slides with Prolong gold antifade reagent.
Coat the edges of the coverslip with a thin layer of clear nail polish and leave to dry for 1 hour at room temperature.
